rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; UK Biobank data from 4 different scanning sites, all using Siemens Skyra 3T with harmonized acquisition parameters
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The data come from 4 different scanning sites."; "The rsfMRI scans were performed using a Siemens Skyra 3T with acquisition parameters harmonized across the four scanning sites."
rci1_using_msad.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Model fitting, L253; Materials and methods / Data, L209

rci2_using_epd.detail: UK Biobank used as the sole reference dataset for normative model training
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We use rsfMRI time series data from the UK-Biobank, which contains rsfMRI data from more than 60k subjects."
rci2_using_epd.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Data, L207

rci3_epd_name.detail: UK Biobank rsfMRI data; UKB ICA parcellation with 55 ICA components
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "We use rsfMRI time series data from the UK-Biobank, which contains rsfMRI data from more than 60k subjects. 46,000 subjects without brain diagnoses... were used for the normative model in an approximately 70:30 train-test split"
rci3_epd_name.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Data, L207

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC; 46,000 healthy subjects split approximately 70:30 into 32,000 training and 14,000 testing
rci5_n.supporting_text: "46,000 subjects without brain diagnoses (International Classification of Disease 10 (ICD-10) category F and G) were used for the normative model in an approximately 70:30 train-test split (32,000 for training the model, 14,000 subjects for out-of-sample testing)"
rci5_n.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Data, L207

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; sex was used as a covariate (coded 0=female, 1=male) but sex breakdown (N per sex) for the training cohort was not reported
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "Sex was coded as a categorical variable with 0 denoting female, 1 denoting male."
rci6_sex.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Model fitting, L253

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; mean and SD not reported for training cohort; age range (44.56-85.43 years) is from the whole dataset (training + test + disease subjects), not training-specific; age in years
rci7_age.supporting_text: "The age variable was linearly transformed the interval [0,1], with 0 and 1 corresponding to the minimum and maximum age in the whole dataset (44.56 and 85.43 years)."
rci7_age.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Model fitting, L253
